claim: From the free Halloween tracing worksheets page, one tap opens the Trace Press book maker with twenty Halloween words filled in; in a phone browser with no sign-up it makes a 46-page handwriting workbook (A to Z, then one word a page with a picture to colour) and its full-wrap KDP cover. The free book carries one footer line and a PREVIEW cover, and $19 once removes them.
notes: Seasonal: Halloween is 2026-10-31. Real-time capture of the live site at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels. The grey ring marks each tap. It ends on pages 27 (bat), 40 (acorn) and 45 (lollipop) of the PDF it just made and on its cover, rendered from those files. The final 2.2 s hold the cover still for the end card.
